data.case_title: Health insurer requests missing documents for knee surgery claim
data.title: Request for additional documents for submitted invoice
data.summary: Beispiel Krankenversicherung a.G. asks Tarek Beispiel for the surgery report (OP-Bericht) and the physiotherapy prescription to process the invoice dated 12 September 2025 for an outpatient knee surgery. The documents are needed within 7 working days of the letter's date, otherwise only the already documented items will be reimbursed.
data.explanation: Your private health insurer needs two more documents (the surgery report and the physiotherapy prescription) to finish checking your submitted invoice for the knee operation. Send them by the deadline shown, computed from the letter's date. If you miss it, the insurer says it will only reimburse the costs it already has documentation for, so you could lose part of the reimbursement. No legal remedy is involved here, just send the paperwork; contact the insurer if you need more time.
